verdict.rationale: Kit's docs show an email editor that uses a saved brand color palette, broadcasts that carry an email template, and custom-field keys used as personalization tags in broadcasts and sequences. That covers the on-brand, template and personalization core, but only through API-reference mentions rather than editor documentation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual/drag-and-drop editor, a reusable template library or management workflow, evidence that personalization renders correctly across email clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: These are the colors available in Kit's editors for emails, forms, and landing pages.
